# er605_wan (Resource)

Network > WAN connection of one port (wan_id 1 = WAN, 2 = WAN/LAN1, ...). proto selects which of the other attributes apply: dhcp (hostname, unicast), static (ipaddr, netmask, gateway), pppoe (username, password, service, mru). Changing a WAN re-dials it: expect a few seconds of outage on that link. Destroy only stops managing the port.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `proto` (String) dhcp, static or pppoe
- `wan_id` (String)

### Optional

- `dns1` (String)
- `dns2` (String)
- `downlink` (Number) kbps
- `gateway` (String)
- `hostname` (String)
- `ipaddr` (String)
- `mru` (Number)
- `mtu` (Number)
- `netmask` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `service` (String)
- `unicast` (Boolean)
- `uplink` (Number) kbps
- `username` (String)
- `vlan_tag` (Boolean)
- `vlanid` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
